name: Torrelacárcel (Spain)
description: Blue field with a hoist part of yellow and red bars with a crenellated edge, from which a yellow point extends to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Torrelacárcel; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe of yellow and red bars with a crenellated edge along the hoist
long yellow point extending from the hoist stripe to the fly
